name: Diageo USVI Captain Morgan Distillery - Frederiksted USVI

fieldNotes.locationResolution: Roster coordinate (17.69168, -64.84829, GEOMETRIC_CENTER) landed on a residential coastal area, NOT the distillery. Web research placed the facility on property bordering Melvin Evans Highway in Estate Diamond, near Henry E. Rohlsen Airport. Located the large industrial complex at ~17.7048, -64.8428 by satellite search along the highway - large white-roofed distillery/warehouse buildings, consistent with the Captain Morgan rum distillery. Locked center moved ~1.6 km NNE of the roster point.
fieldNotes.truckGate: 2016 Street View shows chain-link perimeter fencing around the complex with controlled vehicle access; a large secured industrial rum distillery of this scale is access-controlled. A discrete barrier arm/gate is not crisply resolvable - medium confidence; flagged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth crisply confirmed from imagery; a small structure is visible in the central yard but cannot be positively identified as a staffed gate booth. Left false, with remoteGs true as the more likely pattern - flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the assumption of a gate without a confirmed staffed booth; both this and guardShack are uncertain given limited imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South/southeast building face shows a regular rhythm of dock bays with an apron; ~18 doors estimated, band 10-25, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers and containers parked along the south yard edge; extensive paved yard could hold many more - band 10-25 for currently-occupied stalls.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large paved yard areas around the buildings function as trailer storage / staging.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale resolved in imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main distillery/production building, attached warehouse blocks, and a separate cluster of long barrel-aging warehouses to the northwest (the two ~100K sq ft Captain Morgan barrel warehouses).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access road from Melvin Evans Highway plus large internal yards give ample queuing depth.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Extensive unused paved width across the complex yards offers abundant room to add a dedicated truck lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: On St. Croix outside Frederiksted, bordered by woods and a residential subdivision but well outside any dense urban core - Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail on St. Croix; not rail-served.
fieldNotes.general: Per Virgin Islands Daily News, Diageo announced moving Captain Morgan aging/warehousing to Maryland while rum production stays on St. Croix - barrel-warehouse activity at this site may be winding down.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium overall: the facility was positively located and its layout is clear, but truck-gate/guard-shack specifics rely on dated (2016) and partial Street View plus inference; flagged accordingly.
